item.tib: khrag rkyal thab bzlogs sde brgyad gcun phur
item.coloph: de ltar sde brgyad bcud phur 'di/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' srung bstan skyongs (skyong) rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
